name: Macedonia
overview: Scripture reveals Macedonia as a significant region in the early spread of the gospel, beginning with Paul's vision of a man from Macedonia calling him to come and help (Acts 16:9). Paul responded by preaching in Philippi, the chief city of Macedonia, where he stayed for several days (Acts 16:12). The region was also a center for the early church's generosity, as congregations there sent contributions to support the poor saints in Jerusalem. Additionally, Paul revisited Macedonia multiple times, sending Timothy and others to minister and strengthening the disciples through exhortation (Acts 19:22; Acts 20:1-2).
